by

      (fun t : ℝ => 23 / 11 * (t⁻¹ * Real.exp (-Real.pi / t)))
      (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    integrableOn_inv_mul_exp_neg_pi_div.const_mul _
  have hmono : ∫ t in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      t ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1) * ‖(hurwitzEvenFEPair 0).f_modif t‖ ≤
      ∫ t in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        23 / 11 * (t⁻¹ * Real.exp (-Real.pi / t)) := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg
    · apply MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioo
      intro t ht
      have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) < t := ht.1
      positivity
    · exact hmaj
    · apply MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioo
      intro t ht
      have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) < t := ht.1
      have ht1 : t < 1 := ht.2
      have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / t := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ ht0]
        linarith
      dsimp only
      rw [norm_f_modif_eq_of_lt_one ht0 ht1,
        show ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) from by ring,
        ← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add ht0]
      have hexp : t ^ (-(1 / 2) + -(1 / 2) : ℝ) = t⁻¹ := by
        rw [show (-(1 / 2) + -(1 / 2) : ℝ) = (-1 : ℝ) from by ring,
          Real.rpow_neg_one]
      rw [hexp]
      have hker : evenKernel 0 (1 / t) - 1 ≤
          23 / 11 * Real.exp (-Real.pi * (1 / t)) :=
        evenKernel_zero_sub_one_le_tight hx1
      have harg : Real.exp (-Real.pi * (1 / t)) = Real.exp (-Real.pi / t) := by
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [harg] at hker
      have hinv : (0 : ℝ) < t⁻¹ := by positivity
      nlinarith [hker, hinv]
  refine le_trans hmono ?_
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left integral_Ioo_inv_mul_exp_neg_pi_div_le

theorem logWeighted_zero (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : logWeighted f 0 x = f x := by

  | zero =>
    have hfun : RHTower.logWeighted f 0 = f := funext (logWeighted_zero f)
    rw [hfun]

  | succ t ih =>
    have hfun : RHTower.logWeighted f (t + 1)
        = fun x : ℝ => Real.log x • RHTower.logWeighted f t x :=
      (funext (log_smul_logWeighted f t)).symm
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.log x) (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
      Real.continuousOn_log.mono fun x hx => Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt hx)

      have hlog : (fun x : ℝ => Real.log x) =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 : ℝ)) := by

      have hcollapse : x ^ (1 : ℝ) * x ^ (-(a + 1)) = x ^ (-a) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hx]
        congr 1
        ring

  congr 1
  funext x
  exact log_smul_logWeighted f t x

  have hopen : IsOpen {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re} := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re

    congr 1

We define the Mellin transform of a locally integrable function on `Ioi 0`, and show it is

- `mellin` : the Mellin transform `∫ (t : ℝ) in Ioi 0, t ^ (s - 1) • f t`,

- `HasMellin`: shorthand asserting that the Mellin transform exists and has a given value
  (analogous to `HasSum`).
- `mellin_differentiableAt_of_isBigO_rpow` : if `f` is `O(x ^ (-a))` at infinity, and

    MellinConvergent (fun t => c • f t) s := by

theorem hasDerivAt_mellin_gammaLogIntegrand (t : ℕ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    HasDerivAt (mellin (gammaLogIntegrand t)) (mellin (gammaLogIntegrand (t + 1)) s) s := by

theorem iteratedDeriv_Gamma_eq_mellin (t : ℕ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) :

/-!
# Mellin transform and moments of the standard Gaussian

The Mellin transform of `e^{-π t²}` on the multiplicative half-line is half the real Gamma
factor,

`∫₀^∞ t^{z-1} e^{-π t²} dt = Γ_ℝ(z)/2 = π^{-z/2} Γ(z/2) / 2`   (`Re z > 0`),

obtained from the Gamma integral by the multiplicative substitutions `t ↦ π t` and `t ↦ t²`.
Specializing to real exponents gives the ray moments

`∫₀^∞ t² e^{-π t²} dt = 1/(4π)`,   `∫₀^∞ t⁴ e^{-π t²} dt = 3/(8π²)`.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology MeasureTheory Set

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

/-- The standard Gaussian on the ray, valued in `ℂ`. -/
noncomputable def gaussianKernel (t : ℝ) : ℂ := ((Real.exp (-Real.pi * t ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorem norm_gaussianKernel (t : ℝ) : ‖gaussianKernel t‖ = Real.exp (-Real.pi * t ^ 2) := by
  rw [gaussianKernel, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]

theorem norm_gaussianKernel_eq :
    (fun t : ℝ => ‖gaussianKernel t‖) = fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-Real.pi * t ^ 2) :=
  funext norm_gaussianKernel

theorem continuous_gaussianKernel : Continuous gaussianKernel := by
  unfold gaussianKernel
  fun_prop

/-- The Mellin transform only sees the ray, so two functions agreeing there have the same
transform. -/
theorem mellin_congr_Ioi {f g : ℝ → ℂ} (h : ∀ t ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t = g t) (s : ℂ) :
    mellin f s = mellin g s := by
  simp only [mellin]
  exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun t ht => by rw [h t ht])

/-- Mellin transform of `e^{-x}` is the Gamma function. -/
theorem mellin_exp_neg {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    mellin (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z = Complex.Gamma z := by
  have h := congrFun Complex.GammaIntegral_eq_mellin z
  rw [← h]
  exact (Complex.Gamma_eq_integral hz).symm

/-- Mellin transform of `e^{-π x}`. -/
theorem mellin_exp_neg_pi_mul {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    mellin (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-(Real.pi * x)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z
      = (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ (-z) * Complex.Gamma z := by
  have h := mellin_comp_mul_left (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z Real.pi_pos
  rw [mellin_exp_neg hz] at h
  simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h

/-- **Gaussian Mellin transform.** -/
theorem mellin_gaussianKernel {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    mellin gaussianKernel z = Complex.Gammaℝ z / 2 := by
  have hz2 : 0 < (z / (2 : ℝ)).re := by
    rw [show ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = (2 : ℂ) by norm_num]
    simpa using by linarith [hz]
  have hrpow := mellin_comp_rpow
    (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-(Real.pi * x)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z 2
  have hcongr : mellin gaussianKernel z
      = mellin (fun t : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-(Real.pi * t ^ (2 : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z := by
    refine mellin_congr_Ioi (fun t ht => ?_) z
    have hrp : t ^ (2 : ℝ) = t ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      rw [show (2 : ℝ) = ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [gaussianKernel, hrp]
    norm_num
  rw [hcongr, hrpow, mellin_exp_neg_pi_mul hz2, Complex.Gammaℝ_def]
  rw [show ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = (2 : ℂ) by norm_num]
  rw [show |(2 : ℝ)|⁻¹ = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num]
  rw [Complex.real_smul]
  rw [show (-(z / 2)) = (-z / 2) by ring]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem mellinConvergent_gaussianKernel {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    MellinConvergent gaussianKernel z := by
  refine mellinConvergent_of_isBigO_rpow_exp (a := 1) (b := 0) one_pos
    (continuous_gaussianKernel.continuousOn.locallyIntegrableOn measurableSet_Ioi) ?_ ?_ (by simpa)
  · rw [← Asymptotics.isBigO_norm_left, norm_gaussianKernel_eq]
    have heq : (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 * t)) = fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t) := by
      funext t
      ring_nf
    rw [heq]
    exact (exp_neg_mul_sq_isLittleO_exp_neg Real.pi_pos).isBigO
  · rw [← Asymptotics.isBigO_norm_left, norm_gaussianKernel_eq]
    refine Asymptotics.isBigO_of_le _ (fun x => ?_)
    have hx : x ^ (-0 : ℝ) = 1 := by simp
    rw [hx, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, Real.pi_pos])

/-- Real-exponent form of the Gaussian ray moment. -/
theorem integral_Ioi_rpow_mul_gaussian {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), t ^ (a - 1) * Real.exp (-Real.pi * t ^ 2))
      = Real.pi ^ (-a / 2) * Real.Gamma (a / 2) / 2 := by
  have hz : 0 < ((a : ℂ)).re := by simpa using ha
  have h := mellin_gaussianKernel hz
  rw [mellin] at h
  have hleft : (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((t ^ (a - 1) * Real.exp (-Real.pi * t ^ 2) : ℝ)) : ℂ))
      = Complex.Gammaℝ (a : ℂ) / 2 := by
    rw [← h]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun t ht => ?_)
    have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t := le_of_lt ht
    rw [gaussianKernel, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow ht0]
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  have hcast : (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((t ^ (a - 1) * Real.exp (-Real.pi * t ^ 2) : ℝ)) : ℂ))
      = ((∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), t ^ (a - 1) * Real.exp (-Real.pi * t ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    integral_ofReal
  rw [hcast] at hleft
  have hright : Complex.Gammaℝ (a : ℂ) / 2
      = ((Real.pi ^ (-a / 2) * Real.Gamma (a / 2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by

/-!
# Divisor-free Young bounds for the critical-detector long energy

Finite multiplicative Young gives a complementary unconditional long-energy cap without a divisor
factor.  It is deliberately recorded as a coarse polynomial envelope, not as the sharp Levinson
tail asymptotic.

/-- Divisor-free `ell^2`--`ell^1` cap for the exact long convolution energy. -/
theorem levinsonCriticalDetectorLongEnergy_le_l2_l1
    (lam : ℝ) (L M : ℕ) :
    levinsonCriticalDetectorLongEnergy lam L M ≤
      (∑ n : Fin L,
          ‖Sieve.levinsonCriticalDetectorHeadCoeff lam ((n : ℕ) + 1)‖ ^ 2) *
        (∑ m : Fin M, ‖levinsonLinearMollifierFinCoeff M m‖) ^ 2 := by
  refine (levinsonCriticalDetectorLongEnergy_le_fullEnergy lam L M).trans ?_
  simpa only [levinsonCriticalDetectorMollifiedFinCoeff] using
    Sieve.sum_norm_sq_dirConv_le_l2_l1 L M
      (fun n : Fin L => Sieve.levinsonCriticalDetectorHeadCoeff lam ((n : ℕ) + 1))
      (levinsonLinearMollifierFinCoeff M)

/-- Explicit divisor-free cap using the linear mollifier's square-root `ell^1` mass. -/
theorem levinsonCriticalDetectorLongEnergy_le_four_mul_M_mul_headEnergy
    (lam : ℝ) (L : ℕ) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 < M) :
    levinsonCriticalDetectorLongEnergy lam L M ≤
      4 * M *
        ∑ n : Fin L,
          ‖Sieve.levinsonCriticalDetectorHeadCoeff lam ((n : ℕ) + 1)‖ ^ 2 := by
  let A : ℝ := ∑ n : Fin L,
    ‖Sieve.levinsonCriticalDetectorHeadCoeff lam ((n : ℕ) + 1)‖ ^ 2

/-!
# The four-unit budget and the off-line Cauchy energy

The graded boundary symbol assigns exactly one unit of relative trace to each divisor point,
whatever its multiplicity, so the four-unit budget is a four-vertex budget.  The off-line Cauchy
energy of a packet of divisor points, on the other hand, exceeds four units per point as soon as
every point is off the critical line, because each self-term alone contributes more than one.

Putting the two together, the Cauchy energy of any finite family of off-line `xi` zeros is
strictly larger than four times the graded relative trace of that same family.  Off-line zeros
therefore break the four-unit budget at their own energy scale, and the budget — which is a
statement about the boundary symbol, not about any chosen zero — is a criterion for the critical
line.
-/

/-! ### Off-line data of a divisor point -/

/-- The off-line offset of a spectral point: its distance from the critical line. -/
def xiOfflineOffset (rho : ℂ) : ℝ := |rho.re - 1 / 2|

/-- The height of a spectral point along the critical direction. -/
def xiOfflineHeight (rho : ℂ) : ℝ := rho.im

/-- The divisor multiplicity of a spectral point. -/
def xiDivisorMultiplicity (rho : ℂ) : ℕ := (analyticOrderAt xi rho).toNat

/-- A point off the critical line has positive offset. -/
theorem xiOfflineOffset_pos {rho : ℂ} (h : rho.re ≠ 1 / 2) : 0 < xiOfflineOffset rho :=
  abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h)

/-- A divisor point has offset below one half: the divisor lies inside the critical strip. -/
theorem xiOfflineOffset_lt_half {rho : ℂ} (h : xi rho = 0) : xiOfflineOffset rho < 1 / 2 := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := xi_zero_re_mem_open_unit h
  exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

/-- A divisor point carries at least one unit of multiplicity. -/
theorem one_le_xiDivisorMultiplicity {rho : ℂ} (h : xi rho = 0) :
    1 ≤ xiDivisorMultiplicity rho :=
  Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun hz => (xi_orderToNat_eq_zero_iff rho).mp hz h

/-! ### The bridge -/

/-- **An off-line divisor family exceeds four times its own graded relative trace.**  Each divisor
point contributes exactly one unit of relative trace but strictly more than one unit of Cauchy
self-energy once it is off the critical line, so the four-unit budget of the boundary symbol is
broken by the energy of the very same family. -/
theorem four_mul_trace_lt_xiOfflineCauchyEnergy
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {rho : Fin n → ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ j, xi (rho j) = 0) (hoff : ∀ j, (rho j).re ≠ 1 / 2) :
    4 * Matrix.trace (xiGradedBoundarySymbol rho)
      < finiteOfflineCauchyEnergy (fun j => xiOfflineOffset (rho j))
          (fun j => xiOfflineHeight (rho j)) (fun j => xiDivisorMultiplicity (rho j)) := by
  rw [trace_xiGradedBoundarySymbol]
  simpa using finiteOfflineCauchyEnergy_gt_four_card hn
    (fun j => xiOfflineOffset_pos (hoff j))
    (fun j => xiOfflineOffset_lt_half (hz j))
    (fun j => one_le_xiDivisorMultiplicity (hz j))

/-- No off-line divisor family satisfies the four-unit budget at its own energy. -/
theorem not_xiOfflineCauchyEnergy_le_four_mul_trace
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {rho : Fin n → ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ j, xi (rho j) = 0) (hoff : ∀ j, (rho j).re ≠ 1 / 2) :
    ¬ finiteOfflineCauchyEnergy (fun j => xiOfflineOffset (rho j))
        (fun j => xiOfflineHeight (rho j)) (fun j => xiDivisorMultiplicity (rho j))
      ≤ 4 * Matrix.trace (xiGradedBoundarySymbol rho) :=
  not_le.mpr (four_mul_trace_lt_xiOfflineCauchyEnergy hn hz hoff)

/-- **A single off-line zero already breaks four units.**  The one-vertex boundary graph has
relative trace one, so its budget is exactly four. -/
theorem four_lt_xiOfflineCauchyEnergy_single {rho : ℂ} (hz : xi rho = 0)
    (hoff : rho.re ≠ 1 / 2) :
    4 < finiteOfflineCauchyEnergy (fun _ : Fin 1 => xiOfflineOffset rho)
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => xiOfflineHeight rho) (fun _ : Fin 1 => xiDivisorMultiplicity rho) := by
  have h := four_mul_trace_lt_xiOfflineCauchyEnergy (n := 1) one_pos
    (rho := fun _ : Fin 1 => rho) (fun _ => hz) (fun _ => hoff)
  rwa [trace_xiGradedBoundarySymbol, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at h

/-- **The four-unit budget is a criterion for the critical line.**  If every divisor point meets
the budget at its own Cauchy energy, then no divisor point is off the critical line. -/
theorem xi_zero_re_eq_half_of_four_unit_budget
    (h : ∀ rho : ℂ, xi rho = 0 →
      finiteOfflineCauchyEnergy (fun _ : Fin 1 => xiOfflineOffset rho)
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => xiOfflineHeight rho) (fun _ : Fin 1 => xiDivisorMultiplicity rho) ≤ 4)
    {rho : ℂ} (hz : xi rho = 0) : rho.re = 1 / 2 := by
  by_contra hne
  exact absurd (h rho hz) (not_le.mpr (four_lt_xiOfflineCauchyEnergy_single hz hne))

end

end RHTower

/-
# Finite divisor-prefix orbit nonselection (no jets)

The exact finite divisor already verified on the critical line does not select the type of a later
reflection orbit.  Given arbitrary positive critical-line representatives and multiplicities, the
carrier `lineDivisorPrefix` realizes that divisor exactly.  After attaching any finite exact Euler
head, it admits both:

* a fixed-orbit extension by a new critical-line pair; and
* a free-orbit extension at an arbitrary generic off-line point of the open strip.

Both extensions retain every prescribed old multiplicity exactly, and the added orbit is simple.
The result uses values and divisors only—no derivatives, Taylor data, or jets.

This is a `[BRIDGE]`/no-go theorem, not a numerical amplification of the verified zeta bound: the
constructed carriers are members of the finite-Euler-decorated FE/Schwarz class, not the completed
zeta function.  Its consequence is structural: finite divisor data plus every finite Euler head is
insufficient; any positive amplifier must use a genuinely infinite source constraint that free-orbit
multiplication fails to preserve.
-/
import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.FiniteEulerInert

namespace RHTower

open Complex

/-- The positive critical-line representative of the reflection orbit at ordinate `τ`. -/
def criticalLinePoint (τ : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I

/-- The carrier of a finite critical-line divisor with prescribed multiplicities. -/
def lineDivisorPrefix (S : Finset ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℕ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun s => ∏ τ ∈ S, (linePair τ s) ^ (m τ)

/-- A fixed-orbit extension of a finite critical-line divisor, with a finite Euler head. -/
def fixedOrbitExtension (P : Finset ℕ) (S : Finset ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℕ) (η : ℝ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun s => feBundle P s * (lineDivisorPrefix S m s * linePair η s)

/-- A free-orbit extension of a finite critical-line divisor, with the same finite Euler head. -/
def freeOrbitExtension (P : Finset ℕ) (S : Finset ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℕ) (ρ : ℂ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun s => feBundle P s * (lineDivisorPrefix S m s * orbitQuartic ρ s)

@[simp] theorem criticalLinePoint_re (τ : ℝ) : (criticalLinePoint τ).re = 1 / 2 := by
  simp [criticalLinePoint]

@[simp] theorem criticalLinePoint_im (τ : ℝ) : (criticalLinePoint τ).im = τ := by
  simp [criticalLinePoint]

/-- Evaluation of one crease block at another critical-line representative. -/
theorem linePair_criticalLinePoint (σ τ : ℝ) :
    linePair σ (criticalLinePoint τ) = ((σ ^ 2 - τ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rw [linePair_eq]
  simp only [criticalLinePoint]
  push_cast
  ring_nf
  rw [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

/-- Distinct positive critical-line representatives do not collide. -/
theorem linePair_ne_zero_at_distinct_positive {σ τ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hne : σ ≠ τ) :
    linePair σ (criticalLinePoint τ) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [linePair_criticalLinePoint, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero]
  intro hsq
  have : σ = τ := by nlinarith
  exact hne this

/-- A crease block is nonzero at every off-critical-line point. -/
theorem linePair_ne_zero_at_offline (τ : ℝ) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ.re ≠ 1 / 2) :
    linePair τ ρ ≠ 0 := by
  simp only [linePair, mul_ne_zero_iff, sub_ne_zero]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · apply hρ
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simpa using hre
  · apply hρ
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simpa using hre

/-- A free `V₄` orbit never meets the critical line. -/
theorem orbitQuartic_ne_zero_at_criticalLinePoint {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ.re ≠ 1 / 2) (τ : ℝ) :
    orbitQuartic ρ (criticalLinePoint τ) ≠ 0 := by
  unfold orbitQuartic
  refine mul_ne_zero ?_ (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_) ?_)
  · intro h
    apply hρ
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, criticalLinePoint_re, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    linarith
  · intro h
    apply hρ
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, criticalLinePoint_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    linarith
  · intro h
    apply hρ
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, criticalLinePoint_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    linarith
  · intro h
    apply hρ
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, criticalLinePoint_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.conj_re,
      Complex.zero_re] at hre
    linarith

/-- The finite critical-line divisor carrier has FE and Schwarz symmetry. -/
theorem lineDivisorPrefix_fESchwarz (S : Finset ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℕ) :
    FESchwarz (lineDivisorPrefix S m) := by
  unfold lineDivisorPrefix
  exact FESchwarz.finsetProd S (fun τ s => (linePair τ s) ^ (m τ))
    (fun τ _ => (fESchwarz_linePair τ).pow (m τ))

/-- The finite critical-line carrier realizes every prescribed positive-height multiplicity exactly. -/
theorem lineDivisorPrefix_order (S : Finset ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ τ ∈ S, 0 < τ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ ∈ S) :
    analyticOrderAt (lineDivisorPrefix S m) (criticalLinePoint τ) = m τ := by
  unfold lineDivisorPrefix
